en.headline: Police arrest two over Tai Po gold necklace theft and recover part of chain
en.dek: Officers detained a 37-year-old man and a 29-year-old woman within 24 hours of the theft at a Chow Sang Sang store on Kwong Fuk Road, retrieving part of the 60-gram chain.
body: Police said they arrested a 37-year-old man and a 29-year-old woman on Thursday in connection with the theft of a gold necklace from a Chow Sang Sang jewellery store on Kwong Fuk Road in Tai Po the previous afternoon.

The man, who police said pretended to be a customer and diverted a sales assistant's attention while trying on the chain, fled with the item valued at about HK$79,000 and weighing roughly 60 grams. Officers used the Smart Eye closed-circuit television system to locate him and made the arrest in Tai Po at about 3.30pm; they later detained the woman on suspicion of handling stolen goods and recovered part of the chain.

Tai Po District Crime Squad inspector Mak Ka-ho said the swift resolution was aided by the camera network and tips from jewellery shop staff. Police advised retailers to station a staff member near the entrance when customers try on chains and to avoid one assistant serving multiple people at once.
Correction: typographical error in the Chinese version has been fixed.

zh.headline: 大埔周生生金鏈盜竊案 警方拘捕兩人並起回部分金鏈
zh.dek: 大埔警區重案組今日拘捕一名37歲男子及一名29歲女子，涉於廣福道周生生金行盜取約值7.9萬元、重約60克的金鏈，並起回部分贓物。
body: 警方表示，昨日下午約3時，大埔廣福道一間周生生珠寶金行發生盜竊案，一名男子佟裝顧客選購金飾，試戴一條金鏈期間故意引開售貨員注意後奪門逃走。
大埔警區重案組督察麥嘉昊稱，警方透過銳眼計劃閉路電視系統鎖定疑犯，今日下午約3時半在大埔區拘捕涉嫌偷竊的37歲男子，並檢獲他犯案時所穿衣服；黃昏再拘捕一名涉嫌協助處理贓物的29歲女子，起回被盜金鏈的一部分，正追查其餘部分去向。金鏈重約60克，價值約7.9萬元。
警方建議珠寶及金行業界，在客人試戴金鏈時如人手許可應安排店員站近門口，並避免同一店員同時招呼多名顧客試戴，以防匪徒有機可乘。
更正：已修正中文版本的錯字。
